description: Source of truth for the rights status of every exemplar/demo/marketing asset in Pickleball Coach. Governed by docs/RIGHTS_PLAN.md. No asset ships to a bundled or public surface without a row here whose usage_scope permits that surface.

rights_status_values.cleared-public: Written rights cover public/marketing use of this asset.
rights_status_values.cleared-internal: Usable for development/calibration only; not bundled, not public.
rights_status_values.pending: Rights requested / under negotiation; not yet granted.
rights_status_values.aspirational-reference: A named target studied privately; not a shippable asset.
rights_status_values.prohibited: Must not be used in any shipped or public form.

usage_scope_values.none: Not usable as an asset on any surface.
usage_scope_values.internal-dev: Development/calibration only; never bundled, never public.
usage_scope_values.bundled-app: May ship inside the app binary/reference library.
usage_scope_values.public-marketing: May appear in App Store, web, social, ads, demos, screenshots.
